resources.string: Battery saver or full speed, and CPU overclock
Longer play time. The CPU stays at or below %1$s and the graphics at %2$d MHz. Plenty for 8 and 16-bit games.
Standard speeds. The processor speeds up when a game needs it and slows down when it doesn\'t.
Smoothest emulation. The CPU never drops below %1$s and the graphics run at %2$d MHz all the time. For PS1, N64 and PSP games. The battery runs down faster.
\n\nThe profile is kept when the console restarts. The Quick Settings tile switches to the next one.
\n\nThe profile is kept when the console restarts. FN + R1 and the Quick Settings tile switch to the next one.

Faster emulation for demanding games, at a cost: the console gets warmer, the battery drains faster, and some consoles freeze or crash at the higher speeds. If that happens, pick a lower speed.\n\nThe console always starts at standard speed, a restart turns the overclock off. It also slows down by itself when it gets too hot.
